description: Great ideas don't just win hackathons, they change the world. We are Stalred, a multidisciplinary team united by curiosity, space exploration, and the drive to build meaningful technology for a better future. We combine technical excellence with compelling storytelling to create solutions worthy of Global Nominees. Whether you write code, analyze data, design interfaces, or craft pitches, we want ambitious teammates ready to aim for the stars and go all the way!
